candidate: H44 exact-budget role microcore plus task-modulated procedural expansion atlas
purpose: Test the user's global-basis-plus-basis-free hybrid without storing any ambient basis vector: charge a small continuous core shared by each matrix role and procedurally expand/task-modulate it into node-private ambient atoms.

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: mean of all 239 states independently for each matrix
frozen_inventory.pc_normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for every matrix PC
frozen_inventory.pc_weights: eigenvalue normalized within the measured top-16 set

frozen_decoder.formula: B_n0=D_n; B_nk=unit(sign(D_n) odot H_nk(C_role(n))) for k>0; Yhat_n=sum_k a_nk B_nk
frozen_decoder.core_initialization: deterministic Gaussian followed by unit Frobenius normalization
frozen_decoder.core_retraction: unit Frobenius normalization after every optimizer step
frozen_decoder.hash_expander: procedural independent uniform core-row/core-column lookup vectors plus separable Rademacher signs for every node and branch
frozen_decoder.task_modulation: multiply every expanded branch elementwise by sign(D_n), with zeros mapped to +1

fit.objective: mean eigenvalue-weighted ridge projection capture of each training node's top-16 temporal PCs into its 64 generated atoms
fit.fit_all: learn one shared 320x320 core independently for each three-node role
fit.leave_one_out: learn the role core on the other two same-role nodes; fit only legal 64-dimensional local projection coordinates for the held-out node
fit.base_control: the exact deterministic initial random core frozen, with local coordinates still optimally projected
fit.forbidden_target_access: no held-out PC enters role-core fitting

systems_preflight.preflight_scope: both role fit-all fits plus one held-out fold per role

routing_after_pass: Run the identical microcore atlas on chronological-late and disjoint-stream residual PCs before any LM training.
routing_after_failure: Close this exact microcore hybrid. Write H45 theory and accounting before any code; do not repeat H1/H33 or sweep the microcore.
forbidden_followups: core-size, hash, sign, task-modulation, branch, prompt, seed, ridge, iteration, learning-rate, role, or target sweep
